scope: APT file-transfer UI, shared containers/Unicode helpers, replay voice capture, and exact GameSpy server-browser runtime

applied.name: AptFileTransferPopup_Destroy
applied.evidence: Deletes the global AptFileTransferPopup through its virtual deleting destructor and clears the singleton.
applied.basis: singleton xrefs, vtable ownership, constructor/destructor pair

applied.name: AptFileTransferPopup_FormatPlayerColor
applied.evidence: APT value callback that formats a selected GameSlot player-color identifier as decimal text.
applied.basis: constructor callback registration, slot bounds, GameInfo/GameSlot access

applied.name: MappedCommandHandler_Ctor
applied.evidence: Initializes the shared mapped-command handler base used by eleven APT popup constructors.
applied.basis: constructor call graph and complete-object vtable initialization

applied.name: AptFileTransferPopup_Dtor
applied.evidence: Restores the AptFileTransferPopup vtable, emits FileTransferPopUpClose, clears the singleton, and destroys the base.
applied.basis: named vtable store, exact APT event string, constructor pairing

applied.name: AptFileTransferPopup_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs the 0x64-byte AptFileTransferPopup, maps the eight human GameInfo slots, registers player-color callbacks, and localizes labels.
applied.basis: allocation size, named vtable, APT strings, GameInfo slot loop

applied.name: AptFileTransferPopup_Create
applied.evidence: Creates the singleton 0x64-byte AptFileTransferPopup when absent.
applied.basis: allocation size, constructor call, singleton writes and callers

applied.name: ListNode28Sentinel_Initialize
applied.evidence: Allocates a 28-byte list sentinel and self-links its forward and backward links.
applied.basis: allocation size, exact self-link stores, three unrelated container users

applied.name: UnicodeStringConcatExpression_Ctor
applied.evidence: Builds the three-field lazy Unicode concatenation expression used by replay post-communication and game-state filename generation.
applied.basis: operand stores, Unicode length helper, all four callers

applied.name: Vector60_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Copy-constructs a vector whose elements have a 60-byte stride.
applied.basis: exact end-minus-begin division by 60, reserve/copy helpers, callers

applied.name: RedBlackTree_InitializeSentinel
applied.evidence: Allocates and initializes the red-black-tree head sentinel: color zero, parent null, and left/right self links.
applied.basis: field stores and shared constructor wrapper

applied.name: UnicodeString_FromConcatExpression
applied.evidence: Materializes a lazy Unicode concatenation expression into an owned UTF-16 string buffer.
applied.basis: length calculation, UTF-16 allocation/copy, replay filename callers

applied.name: RedBlackTree_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs the shared red-black-tree container by delegating to its sentinel initializer.
applied.basis: single helper call and three unrelated container users

applied.name: GameMessageVector_DestroyStorage
applied.evidence: Destroys the GameMessage range and frees the vector's backing storage.
applied.basis: GameMessage range destructor, allocator pairing, seven replay callers

applied.name: VoiceManager_PumpAndRecord
applied.evidence: Dequeues captured voice frames, forwards live voice when enabled, and appends VoiceStreamData to an active replay recording.
applied.basis: VoiceStreamData vtable, recorder gates, network forwarding, refcount releases

applied.name: gsifree
applied.evidence: GameSpy SDK memory-free wrapper.
applied.basis: instruction behavior and 631 call sites matching the SDK allocator API

applied.name: SBRefStrHashCleanup
applied.evidence: Frees the global shared SB reference-string table only when its count reaches zero.
applied.basis: instruction-for-source match to GameSpy sb_server.c

applied.name: ArrayFree
applied.evidence: Destroys and frees a GameSpy SDK dynamic array.
applied.basis: instruction-for-source behavior and 22 SDK call sites

applied.name: SBServerListClear
applied.evidence: Moves every server to the dead list, clears the server array, then frees the dead list.
applied.basis: instruction-for-source match to GameSpy sb_serverlist.c

applied.name: ServerListConnect
applied.evidence: Resolves the hashed GameSpy master hostname, opens the TCP socket, and returns the SDK DNS/socket/connect status.
applied.basis: instruction-for-source match including hostname formula and error codes

applied.name: SBServerListDisconnect
applied.evidence: Frees the input buffer and query state, closes the master socket, and resets key/popular-value state.
applied.basis: instruction-for-source match to GameSpy sb_serverlist.c

applied.name: SBServerListCleanup
applied.evidence: Disconnects and clears an SBServerList, releases the shared reference string table, server array, and Unicode last-error buffer.
applied.basis: instruction-for-source match to GameSpy sb_serverlist.c

globals.name: TheAptFileTransferPopup
globals.evidence: Global AptFileTransferPopup singleton written by its constructor/create path and cleared by its destructor/destroy path.
